scope: Output semantic placement only; source detection and technical QA remain independent gates.
source_position_policy: Source coordinates locate content but never determine destination slots. A position-only change with the same verified semantic block types is SUPPORTED_COMPATIBLE, not NEW_LAYOUT.

RIGHT_TOP_TABLE.align: top-right; preserve aspect ratio; expand downward with source row count

RIGHT_MIDDLE_PERFORMANCE.align: same left/right edges as table, below table

MAIN_ENGINEERING.rule: preserve each complete view at one uniform scale; positions are computed from block sizes, never copied from source; no overlap or footer intrusion

PCB.rule: place in central/lower main engineering region, not the right-top table slot; reserve the bottom-right title and tolerance cells

BOTTOM_TOLERANCE.rule: approved English sparse tolerance block; values source-bound

promotion_gate: This semantic slot rule is compatible across source positions. A source-family locator remains CANDIDATE until distinct-source generation and QA pass; no golden recipe is altered.
